**The document does not report SimPO being applied to Llama-3-70B, so it gives no AlpacaEval 2 LC win rate for that.**

Llama-3-70B appears only once, as the unmodified **Llama-3-70B-Instruct** in the AlpacaEval 2 leaderboard comparison (Table 1, page 2). Its scores there are 34.4% LC, 33.2% WR and an average length of 1919. That is the off-the-shelf model, not one trained with SimPO.

The paper uses SimPO only on smaller models:

- **Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B**, each in Base and Instruct setups (page 4).
- **Gemma-2-9B-it**, its strongest model (pages 4 and 31).

The closest Llama-3 results are both 8B:

- **Llama-3-8B-Instruct-SimPO:** 44.7% LC on AlpacaEval 2 (Table 1, page 2; Table 4, page 6).
- **Llama-3-8B-Instruct-SimPO v0.2:** 53.7% LC, using the stronger ArmoRM reward model (Table 12, page 29).
